text: Lactic acid bacteria and yeasts sour the milk in a gourd lined with charcoal dust. The charcoal absorbs the 'cowy' flavours of fresh milk, adds its own smoky taste and turns the milk the bluish-grey colour that Kalenjin farmers prize.

links.name: Mureithi et al., Journal of Ethnobiology 20(1) (2000)
